title: Turn a song into a world
intro: Upload an MP3, WAV or FLAC file (25 MB and 3 minutes max). Add timed lyrics as an .lrc file if you have them.
royaltyNote: Only upload music you have the rights to use.
dataNote: To design your world, a text summary of your song (key, tempo, notes, lyrics) is sent to Meta's Muse model, which Meta may use to train its models.
stage.separate: Separating vocals, drums, bass and instruments
